dialogue.text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I notice you are appearing quite agitated; can you tell me when these feelings of aggression and confusion first began?

I don't know why everyone is making such a big deal out of this, I just have a lot to get done for my finals! I've been feeling keyed up all day, so I went to the gym to blow off some steam, but I still can't seem to slow down. My roommates need to mind their own business before I lose it again.

Have you taken any new medications, stimulants, or pre-workout supplements recently to help with your studies or gym session? I'm going to check your vitals now to see how your body is responding.

REQUEST TEST: Vital_Signs
RESULTS: Temperature: 101°F (38.3°C), Blood_Pressure: 137/98 mmHg, Heart_Rate: 120/min, Respiratory_Rate: 23/min, Oxygen_Saturation: 99% on room air

Your temperature and heart rate are significantly elevated. Are you experiencing any physical symptoms like muscle stiffness, tremors, or excessive sweating?

REQUEST TEST: Physical_Exam
RESULTS: Appearance: Irritable young man; Skin: Notable diaphoresis; Heart: Tachycardia; Lungs: Bilateral clear breath sounds; Pupils: Notably dilated; Mental_Status: Rapid speech, aggressive

Your pupils are dilated and you are sweating quite a bit. Besides the gym supplements, have you used any recreational drugs or been prescribed any new psychiatric medications recently?

REQUEST TEST: Urine_Toxicology_Screen
RESULTS: Amphetamines: Positive, Cocaine: Negative, Opiates: Negative, Benzodiazepines: Negative, Cannabinoids: Negative

The amphetamines in your system explain much of your current state, but I'm concerned about your high temperature. Have you noticed any significant muscle pain or noticed if your urine has become a dark, tea-like color?

REQUEST TEST: Serum_Creatine_Kinase
RESULTS: NORMAL READINGS

Are you experiencing any chest pain or palpitations along with this restlessness? I'm going to check your heart's electrical activity now to ensure everything is functioning correctly.

REQUEST TEST: EKG
RESULTS: NORMAL READINGS

Are you currently taking any antidepressants or other prescription medications for your mood? I'm going to run a blood test to check your electrolyte levels and kidney function.

REQUEST TEST: Basic_Metabolic_Panel
RESULTS: Sodium: Normal, Potassium: Normal, Creatinine: Normal, Blood_Glucose: Normal

Since your metabolic panel is normal, I'd like to check for any involuntary muscle movements or "jumpiness" in your legs. Do you feel like your muscles are twitching or jerking on their own?

REQUEST TEST: Neurological_Exam
RESULTS: Pupils: Notably dilated, Mental_Status: Rapid speech, aggressive; Appearance: Irritable young man; Skin: Notable diaphoresis

Have you experienced any seizures, or did you take a much higher dose of your study aids than usual? I'm going to check your reflexes for any abnormal rhythmic jerking.

REQUEST

I told you, I haven't had any seizures and I'm just doing what I have to do to pass my exams! Why are you touching me and asking all these questions when I clearly just need to get back to studying? Just leave me alone or I'm going to walk out of here!

Everything is blurry and moving too fast, and my head feels like it's about to explode! Why are the lights in here so bright? Just get away from me and let me go back to my room!

I will dim the lights for you to help with the headache. Have you noticed your muscles twitching specifically in your legs or any unusual jumping when you move? 

REQUEST TEST: Neurological_Exam_Reflexes
RESULTS: NORMAL READINGS

Are you experiencing any neck stiffness or pain when you try to move your head? I'm also going to check for any signs of skin rashes or track marks.
